name: tree
description: Display directories as trees (with optional color/HTML output)

options.name: -a
options.description: All files are listed

options.name: -d
options.description: List directories only

options.name: -l
options.description: Follow symbolic links like directories

options.name: -f
options.description: Print the full path prefix for each file

options.name: -x
options.description: Stay on current filesystem only

options.name: -L
options.description: Descend only level directories deep

options.name: -R
options.description: Rerun tree when max dir level reached

options.name: -P
options.description: List only those files that match the pattern given

options.name: -I
options.description: Do not list files that match the given pattern

options.name: --ignore-case
options.description: Ignore case when pattern matching

options.name: --matchdirs
options.description: Include directory names in -P pattern matching

options.name: --noreport
options.description: Turn off file/directory count at end of tree listing

options.name: --charset
options.description: Use charset X for terminal/HTML and indentation line output

options.name: --filelimit
options.description: Do not descend dirs with more than # files in them

options.name: --timefmt
options.description: Print and format time according to the format <f>

options.name: -o
options.description: Output to file instead of stdout

options.name: -q
options.description: Print non-printable characters as '?'

options.name: -N
options.description: Print non-printable characters as is

options.name: -Q
options.description: Quote filenames with double quotes

options.name: -p
options.description: Print the protections for each file

options.name: -u
options.description: Displays file owner or UID number

options.name: -g
options.description: Displays file group owner or GID number

options.name: -s
options.description: Print the size in bytes of each file

options.name: -h
options.description: Print the size in a more human readable way

options.name: --si
options.description: Like -h but use SI units (powers of 1000) instead

options.name: --du
options.description: For each directory report its size as the accumulation of sizes of all its files and sub-directories (and their files, and so on). The total amount of used space is also given in the final report (like the 'du -c' command.) This option requires tree to read the entire directory tree before emitting it, see BUGS AND NOTES below. Implies -s

options.name: -D
options.description: Print the date of the last modification time or if -c is used, the last status change time for the file listed

options.name: -F
options.description: Appends '/', '=', '*', '@', '|' or '>' as per ls -F

options.name: --inodes
options.description: Print inode number of each file

options.name: --device
options.description: Print device ID number to which each file belongs

options.name: -v
options.description: Sort files alphanumerically by version

options.name: -t
options.description: Sort files by last modification time

options.name: -c
options.description: Sort files by last status change time

options.name: -U
options.description: Leave files unsorted

options.name: -r
options.description: Reverse the order of the sort

options.name: --dirsfirst
options.description: List directories before files (-U disables)

options.name: --sort
options.description: Select sort

options.name: -i
options.description: Don't print indentation lines

options.name: -A
options.description: Print ANSI lines graphic indentation lines

options.name: -S
options.description: Print with CP437 (console) graphics indentation lines

options.name: -n
options.description: Turn colorization off always (-C overrides)

options.name: -C
options.description: Turn colorization on always

options.name: -X
options.description: Prints out an XML representation of the tree

options.name: -J
options.description: Prints out an JSON representation of the tree

options.name: -H
options.description: Prints out HTML format with baseHREF as top directory

options.name: -T
options.description: Replace the default HTML title and H1 header with string

options.name: --nolinks
options.description: Turn off hyperlinks in HTML output

options.name: --fromfile
options.description: Reads paths from files

options.name: --version
options.description: Print version and exit

options.name: --help
options.description: Print usage and this help message and exit
Options processing terminator
